shared_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly polished, visually distinctive concept board for Calgary Crocs underwater hockey club software. Input images 1 and 2 are style references from Ishaan Dey's Arceus project: translate their visual grammar into THIS sports club app, not their compute business features. No Arceus brand or compute content. Study the dense near-black instrument panels, inset thin warm borders, rich restrained accent lighting, expressive numeric type, uppercase monospaced labels, subtle LCD ticks, and functional information density. This must be a real stylistic step beyond a plain minimal black app. Personality comes from panel architecture, typography, controlled light, small purposeful technical graphics and sporty detail. Not a generic SaaS admin dashboard, not a childish gamified app, no giant hero illustration or stock pool photography.
Composition: one landscape design board, large complete desktop Home application occupying about two-thirds width and a complete full-height phone Home screen beside it occupying one-third. Both front-on, no perspective, physical device hardware, mockup scene, laptop or giant margins. A small concept name above. Both same design system and clear readable UI; desktop dense but purposeful, phone simplified and touch-friendly. Do not reproduce the angled reference photograph.
Desktop header brand "CROCS / UWH". Sidebar navigation "Home", "Schedule", "Messages", "Account", "Club", Home selected. Main title "Good evening, Alex". Main featured panel "NEXT PRACTICE" with large date "THU 29 OCT", linked "Thursday training" and chevron, "7:45–9:30 PM", "MNP Sport Centre". Compact attendance rows You, Sam, Mila with separate Yes and No buttons. You and Mila Yes selected green, Sam No selected muted red; accent color must NOT replace these semantic states. Three clearly clickable grouped actions Attendance / Plan / Teams. Adjacent useful panel "CURRENT GOAL", "Create space after the pass", "3/6 check-ins" with a segmented LCD-like six-part progress indicator exactly half filled and "Check in" button. Another useful compact panel "FITNESS TESTS", "50 m swim", latest "1:30", small green down arrow "0:03", "Best 1:30"; "Pool lengths" latest "18", green up arrow "2". A small "COACH NOTE" panel reading "Great support play. Keep moving after the pass." and a quiet "CLUB NEWS" row "Welcome to the new season". A small functional Teams preview may show a simple pool outline and player dots, not a meaningless network graph.
Phone: compact brand row "CROCS / UWH", greeting "Hi Alex", featured practice date/title/time/location, compact three-person attendance Yes/No rows, grouped Attendance / Plan / Teams buttons; small current goal progress panel and compact club news row if space. Fixed bottom navigation Home / Schedule / Messages / Account / Club. No duplicated desktop sidebar in phone.
Constraints: keep title sizes reasonable and readable, uppercase mono only for small panel labels and numeric readouts, legible neutral sans for names/body. Strong whites and readable secondary labels, not washed-out gray. Fine inset borders and aligned card seams, purposeful compact status lights. No random charts, money, stock graphs, AI/network diagrams, decorative fake telemetry, coins, leaderboards, trophies, giant empty black space, cartoon mascot, hockey sticks or gear. Subtle ambient glow must be localized and smooth, no coarse grain, noisy shader, glowing body text or blurry controls. Brand original, inspired by reference not copied. No watermark.

variants.name: 09-amber-poolside
variants.style: Concept title "09 / POOLSIDE INSTRUMENTS". Closest to the reference's art direction: almost-black warm charcoal surfaces, smoked bronze panel edging, ember-orange primary accent and localized warm orange bloom behind a few key readouts and the current-goal progress ticks. Use the visual spirit of Supply Mono for uppercase captions and Montreal-like grotesk for clean names/body. Off-white large numbers with a subtly condensed athletic feel. Brighter orange for selected navigation marker, small section glyphs and primary Check in button, never flood the whole interface orange. Use a very subtle warm vignette in outer board only; inside app crisp. Panel anatomy should feel like beautifully engineered training instrumentation, tactile refined black sports hardware rather than futuristic sci-fi HUD. Include fine vertical divider rhythm and subtle striped progress treatment. Visually rich and confident, strong hierarchy, not merely the last minimal dark concept with orange swapped in.

variants.name: 10-deep-green-instruments
variants.style: Concept title "10 / DEEP WATER CONTROL". Preserve the reference's instrument-panel richness but create a distinctive Crocs brand direction: carbon-black and extremely deep forest green surfaces, luminous jade/sea-glass accents, off-white type, a tiny warm amber secondary accent only for upcoming practice date. Carefully localized emerald edge-lighting and gentle green bloom behind selected progress ticks, matte graphite borders, layered green-black panels with beautifully aligned seams. Technical uppercase mono captions paired with slightly condensed modern grotesk titles and large sporty numeric time/date readouts. Sparse pool-lane linework can become an elegant tiny header motif; no waves mural or full-page shader. Make green richer and more atmospheric than the app's old flat muddy green. A sense of crafted sports equipment / precision pool control room, with organic club warmth retained through short labels and names. Readable functional contrast. No neon green everywhere or arcade styling. More material and information-rich than the earlier quiet Fey-like design.
